1.speaker: シャロ
1.original: （あれ、もう夕方？\n　いつの間にか寝ちゃってたんだ）
1.translation: (What? It's already nighttime? \nI guess I fell asleep at some point.)

2.speaker: シャロ
2.original: （千夜が作ってくれたおかゆを食べて、\n　薬を飲んで、そのまま１日中……）
2.translation: (I had the porridge Chiya brought me, \ntook some medicine, \nand then a full day...)

3.speaker: シャロ
3.original: （おかげで、だいぶ、楽にはなったわね。\n　もう動けそうだわ）
3.translation: (Thanks to that, \nI'm already feeling a lot better. \nI can probably get back on my feet again.)

4.speaker: シャロ
4.original: 時間は……\nうん、今からならバイトに間に合いそう。
4.translation: The time...\nGood, if I get moving now, I can probably \nmake it in time for work.

5.speaker: 千夜
5.original: だめよ。\nバイトになんて行かせないわ。
5.translation: Nuh-uh. \nI can't let you do something like go to work.

7.speaker: 千夜
7.original: 私がいるのに気づかないってことは、\nまだ熱でボーッとしてるのよ。
7.translation: I'm right here, but you didn't notice a thing. \nThe fever is still preventing you from \nthinking straight.

8.speaker: シャロ
8.original: そんなことないわ、もう起きられるから。
8.translation: That's not true. \nI can already get up just fine.

9.speaker: 千夜
9.original: ちょっと楽になったからって、無理しちゃだめ。
9.translation: Don't overdo it just because you're feeling \nslightly better.

11.speaker: シャロ
11.original: あれ？\nなんだかいい匂いがする。
11.translation: Wait. Something smells good in here?

12.speaker: 千夜
12.original: そろそろ起きる頃かと思って、\nおかゆを作ってきたの。
12.translation: I thought it's about time you'd wake up, \nso I brought more porridge.

13.speaker: 千夜
13.original: 朝は、薬を飲むために\nちょっと食べただけでしょう？\nそろそろお腹が減ってると思って。
13.translation: This morning, you only had a few bites to get \nthe medicine down, right? I expect you've \ngotten hungry by now.

16.speaker: 千夜
16.original: ふうふうしてあげましょうか？
16.translation: Shall I blow on it for you?

17.speaker: シャロ
17.original: いいわよ、子どもじゃないんだから。\nいただきます。
17.translation: Don't bother, I'm not a little kid. \nItadakimasu.

19.speaker: 千夜
19.original: ふふふ、ありがとう。\n慌てていた朝と違って、\n腕によりをかけて作ったかいがあるわ。
19.translation: Hehehe, thank you. This isn't like the stuff I \nwhipped up this morning, I gave my best \neffort making this batch.

20.speaker: 千夜
20.original: それに、食べておいしいって感じるのなら、\nよくなってきてるってことよね。
20.translation: But more importantly, the fact that you can \ntaste the food means that you've \ngotten better.

22.speaker: シャロ
22.original: 千夜、学校、本当に休んだの？
22.translation: Chiya, did you seriously skip school today?

23.speaker: 千夜
23.original: 気にしないで。\n私が勝手にしたことなんだから。
23.translation: Don't worry about that. I did it all on my own.

25.speaker: 千夜
25.original: 本当にいいのよ。\nおかげで貴重な体験ができたもの。
25.translation: It's completely fine. Thanks to this I received \na valuable experience.

27.speaker: 千夜
27.original: 熱のせいで覚えてないみたいだけど、\nシャロちゃんたらね、かわいかったのよ？
27.translation: I don't think you remember anything due to the \nfever, but Sharo-chan really was the cutest \nthing today.

28.speaker: 千夜
28.original: 体を拭いてあげようと思って、\nパジャマを脱いでって頼んだら――
28.translation: I thought I would wipe the sweat off your body \nearlier, and when I asked you to take off \nyour pajamasーー

29.speaker: 千夜
29.original: 子どもみたいにバンザイをしてね、\n脱がせて～ってお願いしてきたのよ？
29.translation: Like a child, you threw your hands in the air \nand shouted ”banzai!” and asked me to pull \noff your shirt.

30.speaker: シャロ
30.original: えええっ！？\nう、嘘よ、そんなの！
30.translation: Eeeeh!? There's no way that actually happened!

33.speaker: 千夜
33.original: 食べられるなら残りも食べちゃって。\nそのあとで、ちゃんとお薬も飲むこと。
33.translation: If you can stomach it, try and finish it all. \nAfter that, don't forget to take your \nmedicine.

34.speaker: シャロ
34.original: ……わかってるわ。\n子どもじゃないったら。
34.translation: ...I get it already. I'm not a kid.

35.speaker: 千夜
35.original: 他に、何か欲しいものはある？
35.translation: Other than that, is there anything you'd like?

37.speaker: シャロ
37.original: あ、そうだ。\nフルールに、今日はバイト休むって\n連絡入れないと。
37.translation: Ah, at the very least, I need to call Fleur \nand tell them I can't come in.

38.speaker: 千夜
38.original: それじゃ、私がしておくから、\nシャロちゃんはそのまま休んでいて。
38.translation: I'll go do that, \nyou stay right here and get your rest.

39.speaker: シャロ
39.translation: ...Sorry about that, \nand all the other stuff you've done today.

40.speaker: 千夜
40.translation: Like I said, don't worry about it.

41.speaker: シャロ
41.original: うん。\nうん、本当に、ありがと。

44.speaker: 千夜
44.original: はい。\n……ええ、大丈夫よ。\n鍵は開いているから入ってきて。
44.translation: Yes. ...Yes, it's fine. \nThe door's unlocked, come on in.

45.speaker: シャロ
45.original: ちょっと千夜？\nその電話って誰から――
45.translation: Hang on, Chiya? Who was that just nowーー

48.speaker: ココア
48.translation: The cold didn't kill you did it!?

49.speaker: シャロ
49.original: え、ええ。\n見ての通り、だいぶよくなってきたわ。
49.translation: Y-Yeah. Your eyes do not deceive you, \nI'm basically back to normal.

50.speaker: リゼ
50.original: そうか、それはよかった。

51.speaker: チノ
51.original: はい。\n思ったよりもお元気そうで、何よりです。
51.translation: Good. \nYou seem to be doing better than expected.\nI'm relieved.

52.speaker: シャロ
52.original: リゼ先輩！\nチノちゃんも、どうして？
52.translation: Rize-senpai! And Chino-chan as well, what are \nyou doing here?

53.speaker: リゼ
53.original: シャロが風邪をひいたって、\n千夜から連絡をもらったんだよ。\nそれで、お見舞いに来たんだ。
53.translation: Chiya contacted us and told us all about your \ncold. So we all came to see how you were doing.

54.speaker: シャロ
54.original: そんな……お見舞いなんて。\n風邪がうつっちゃったら大変なのに。
54.translation: You didn't have to do something like that... \nIt'll be terrible if you catch my cold.

55.speaker: ココア
55.original: そんな心配しなくていいんだよ。\nむしろ、シャロちゃんは心配される側なんだから。
55.translation: Don't worry about something like that! It's \nthe other way around, we should be the ones \nworried right now.

56.speaker: ココア
56.original: 私たちは、うがいとか手洗いを\nいっぱいするから大丈夫！
56.translation: We'll all make sure to do lots of hand \nwashing and gargling, no need to fear!

57.speaker: チノ
57.original: 今は、自分の体のことを１番に考えてください。
57.translation: For today, please put your own health first.

58.speaker: 千夜
58.original: そうよ。\nシャロちゃんが寝込んでいたら、\n私たちまで元気がなくなっちゃうんだから。
58.translation: That's right. Sharo-chan being laid up in bed \nmakes us all depressed too.

60.speaker: シャロ
60.original: （どうしよう……。\n　みんなの気持ちが嬉しいのに……）
60.translation: (What should I say...\nI appreciate the thought from everyone, \nbut...)

61.speaker: シャロ
61.original: （それと同じくらい、申し訳ない気分だわ。\n　クリスマスパーティーのことで、あんなにも\n　心配かけたのに、またこんな風に……）
61.translation: (At the same time, I feel like I should apologize.\nIt's like a repeat of when everyone was\nworried about me with the Christmas party...)

62.speaker: リゼ
62.original: それにしても、しっかり者のシャロが\nここまで体調を崩すとはな。
62.translation: But still, our powerhouse Sharo has come this \nfar in wrecking her health, huh.

63.speaker: ココア
63.original: やっぱり、\n１人でクリスマスパーティーの準備なんて\n無理をさせちゃったせいだよね。
63.translation: In the end, this is all because we made you \nattempt the impossible by preparing the \nChristmas party all alone.

64.speaker: チノ
64.original: すみませんでした。\nシャロさんの負担も考えずに……。
64.translation: I beg your forgiveness. We didn't consider the \nburden you were carrying...

65.speaker: シャロ
65.original: そ、そんなことないわ！\n風邪ひいちゃったのは私の不注意のせいよ。\nパーティーのことは関係ないから。
65.translation: That's not true at all! Coming down with a \ncold was from my own carelessness. It has \nnothing to do with the party.

66.speaker: シャロ
66.original: それに、主催を買って出たのは私なんだし、\nみんなが悪く思うことなんて１つも……。
66.translation: And on top of that, the one who volunteered \nto host the party was me. You all don't have \na single thing to feel bad about.

67.speaker: 千夜
67.original: シャロちゃん。\nそんなに思いつめないで。
67.translation: Sharo-chan. Don't think about it so hard.

69.speaker: 千夜
69.original: それに、みんなも。\nシャロちゃんのことが心配なのはわかるけど、\nあまり自分を責めたりしちゃだめ。
69.translation: And that goes for everyone. I understand that \nyou're all worried about Sharo-chan's situation,\nbut don't go blaming yourself over it.

70.speaker: 千夜
70.original: 今回は、たまたまタイミングが悪かっただけ。\n誰が悪いとか、そういうことはないのよ。
70.translation: This whole thing was an unlucky case of\nbad timing.\nThis wasn't anybody's fault.

71.speaker: リゼ
71.original: ……ああ、そうだな。\n千夜の言う通りだ。
71.translation: ...Yeah, that's right. \nIt's just as Chiya says.

72.speaker: リゼ
72.original: すまない、シャロ。\n風邪で体が弱っている時に、\n余計な気遣いをさせてしまって。
72.translation: Sorry, Sharo. Even though you're weakened with\na cold, we still ended up making you worried.

74.speaker: ココア
74.original: とりあえず今は、風邪を治すことが最優先！\nそうだよね、シャロちゃん。
74.translation: But for now, the highest priority is getting \nrid of that cold! Isn't that right, \nSharo-chan?

75.speaker: チノ
75.original: あの、遅くなりましたが、\nお見舞いに、栄養がありそうなものを\n買ってきたんです。
75.translation: Um, I know this is kind of late, but for our \nvisit we brought you some foods we thought \nwould be nutritious.

76.speaker: ココア
76.original: ああっ！　そうだった！\nみんなで元気が出そうな食べ物を選んで――
76.translation: Ah, that's right! We all picked out different \nfoods we thought would cheer you upーー

77.speaker: ココア
77.original: あ、それ、おかゆ食べてたの？
77.translation: Oh, have you already had some porridge?

78.speaker: 千夜
78.original: 今日はおかゆしか食べてないし、\nきっとまだまだ食べられると思うわよ？
78.translation: She hasn't had anything to eat other than \nporridge today, so she probably has room to \neat plenty more.

79.speaker: リゼ
79.original: 病み上がりなんだから、\n無理に食べることもないだろ。\n冷蔵庫に入れておくから。
79.translation: Since you're just getting over your sickness, \ndon't try to force anything down. We'll \nleave this in your fridge.

80.speaker: ココア
80.original: あ、ねえ、待って！\nプリンくらいなら食べられるよね？\nはい！
80.translation: Hey, wait! I'm sure you can eat something \neasy like pudding, right? Here you go!

81.speaker: チノ
81.original: ココアさん？\nどうしてプリンが人数分あるんですか？
81.translation: Cocoa-san? Why do you multiple servings of \npudding?

82.speaker: ココア
82.original: だって、みんなで食べた方がおいしいと思って。
82.translation: Because it'll taste better if we all eat it \ntogether! I think.

83.speaker: チノ
83.original: 単に自分が食べたかっただけですよね？
83.translation: So, you just wanted to eat some yourself?

84.speaker: ココア
84.original: 違うよ～！\n私はシャロちゃんのためを思って――
84.translation: You've got it all wrong! \nI was thinking of Sharo-chan the entire timeーー

86.speaker: ココア
86.original: ん？　シャロちゃん、どうかした？

87.speaker: シャロ
87.original: ううん。\nなんだか、この雰囲気が懐かしくて。
87.translation: It's nothing. Somehow, I think I'm getting \nattached to this kind of atmosphere.

88.speaker: 千夜
88.original: そういえば、最近あまり\nみんなで集まっていなかったものね。
88.translation: Now that I think about it, we haven't gotten \ntogether recently, have we?

89.speaker: リゼ
89.original: 期末試験があったり、クリスマスが近くて\n店が忙しかったりしたからな。
89.translation: I guess at first it was finals, and now Christmas\nis drawing near, so our cafes are all busy.

90.speaker: ココア
90.original: じゃあ、今日は夜まで\nみんなでシャロちゃんの看病をしようよ。
90.translation: I know, for today let's all nurse Sharo-chan \nback to health until it gets dark!

91.speaker: シャロ
91.original: い、いいわよ、そんな。\n本当に風邪がうつっちゃったらどうするのよ。
91.translation: Y-You don't have to do all that. How am I \ngoing to live with myself if I end up becoming \na superspreader?

92.speaker: ココア
92.original: 大丈夫だよ。\nちゃーんと手洗いうがいをするからね。
92.translation: There's nothing to worry about. We'll all \nproperly wash our hands and gargle.

93.speaker: チノ
93.original: では、父に連絡してきます。
93.translation: Allow me to go call my father.

94.speaker: シャロ
94.original: あ、チノちゃん！？\nもう、みんな勝手に決めて……。
94.translation: Ah, Chino-chan!? Gosh, so you're all just \ngoing on ahead and doing this...

95.speaker: 千夜
95.original: あら、シャロちゃんは嬉しくないの？
95.translation: Oh, Sharo-chan? Aren't you happy about it?

97.speaker: リゼ
97.original: 遠慮するな。\n風邪をひいた時くらい、甘えていいんだぞ。
97.translation: Make yourself comfortable. At least when you're\nsick, it's totally fine to let us take care \nof you.

98.speaker: シャロ
98.original: 先輩……。\nじゃあ、お言葉に甘えて……。
98.translation: Senpai... \nWell then, I'll take up your offer...

99.speaker: ココア
99.original: よーし！\nじゃあ、ばりばり看病しちゃうよ！
99.translation: Alright! Now then, we're going to furiously \nhave you rehabilitated!

100.speaker: シャロ
100.original: できれば、ココアは大人しくしてて。\nあんたが張り切ると何か失敗しそうだから。
100.translation: If it's possible, I'd prefer if Cocoa quietly \nsat this out. When you get this amped up it \nmakes me feel like this is doomed to fail.
